responsibility: Implements the Resolver2_0 late name-resolution pass for ordinary Rust identifiers, paths, and type names after top-level and macro-related resolution have populated the namespace stacks. This file seeds builtin type names into the type namespace and the type-checking context, records local bindings such as identifier patterns into value ribs, resolves identifier expressions and expression paths through label and value ForeverStacks, resolves type paths and struct-constructor references through the type namespace, and writes usage-to-definition mappings for later semantic phases.
same_name_distinction: Implements Late’s concrete post-macro resolution work, including seeding builtin types, inserting local identifier bindings into value ribs, resolving identifier and path uses in value/type namespaces, and recording usage-to-definition mappings; the paired header only declares those entry points and visit overrides.
